patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Kaspr and 6sense share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Kaspr and 6sense share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Kaspr only if your buying job matches “LinkedIn-centric EU/EMEA B2B contact capture (Chrome) — Free plan; Starter from $49/mo ann” rather than 6sense's shape. Choose 6sense only if your buying job matches “Enterprise ABM and sales intelligence platform for predictive intent, account prioritizati” rather than Kaspr's shape. Workflow advantage differs because Kaspr is shaped for LinkedIn-centric EU/EMEA B2B contact capture (Chrome) — Free plan; Sta whereas 6sense is shaped for Enterprise ABM and sales intelligence platform for predictive intent, . Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Kaspr and 6sense share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Kaspr is LinkedIn-centric EU/EMEA B2B contact capture (Chrome) — Free plan; Starter from $49/mo annual headline.; 6sense is Enterprise ABM and sales intelligence platform for predictive intent, account prioritization, and revenue-team orchestration — custom-quote .
- Company-size focus: Kaspr (small-business, mid-market) vs 6sense (mid-market, enterprise).
- Researched limits: Kaspr — LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies; 6sense — Seat and module prices are not published — packaging is custom quote.

Limitations — Kaspr: LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies; Native email outreach/sequencing depth is limited versus engagement platforms; 6sense: Seat and module prices are not published — packaging is custom quote; Enterprise ABM / predictive stack carries material implementation and admin overhead.

Poor-fit cases: Kaspr is a poor fit when that limitation bites: LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies · 6sense is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Seat and module prices are not published — packaging is custom quote · Avoid Kaspr if you actually need 6sense's motion (Enterprise ABM and sales intelligence platform for predictive intent, account pr)
